text: Rubaya, in eastern Congo, produces about 15% of the world’s tantalum, a metal used in phones and laptops. M23 took control of the mines in 2024.

source.name: Global Witness
source.quote: These looted minerals come from mines in Rubaya in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), which produce 15% of the world’s tantalum

additionalSources.name: Reuters (Reade Levinson, David Lewis, Sonia Rolley), 'Major Rwandan coltan exporter bought smuggled Congolese minerals, UN report says' (read via Yahoo News syndication)
additionalSources.quote: Rubaya, the Congolese mining area now controlled by M23, produces 15% of the world's coltan.
